body:
**Checked on a real project.** The contributor ran the GUI on `test-423.camproj` (two setups; Face top and Hole 6mm in Setup1, Outside profile in Setup2). The post-options half was then driven headlessly through this branch's own commands on that same file.

**GUI (contributor, hands-on)**
- Setup1's Tool list page lists its 2 tools in change order, with time estimates.
- **Export tool list…** wrote `Setup1-tools.csv` (`T,Tool,Diameter mm,Kind,Holder,Operations`, one row per tool) and a fixed-column `.txt` (`TOOL LIST - Setup1` … `2 tool(s)`). The status line confirmed each write.
- Setup2's tool list shows its 1 tool.

**Per-setup post options (commands on the real file; every operation given a program stop after it)**
| Step | Stops posted (Face top / Hole 6mm / Outside profile) |
|---|---|
| Baseline | ✓ ✓ ✓ |
| `SetSetupPostOptions(Setup1, own, skip pauses and homes)` | ✗ ✗ ✓. Setup2 follows the document and keeps its stop |
| Same, with Setup2 active | ✗ ✗ ✓. Each op reads its own setup's switch |
| Save → reopen | Setup1 keeps its own options; Setup2 still follows |
| Undo | Setup1 follows the document again; the post is byte-identical to the baseline |

The PR's suites: app `setup_post_options` 8/8 and ui lib `setup_post_options` 3/3.

**Not exercised:** clicking the Post page radio and checkbox by hand. `the_post_page_radio_gives_the_setup_its_own_options` covers it through the UI state.

Marking ready for review (contributor OK).

Review fix pushed (`7fa0fbee`, merged current main). Besides the module-list conflicts, a semantic merge with #155 and #388:
- `program_entry::posted_afters` now takes a per-op skip predicate, so each op's after-action follows its own setup's "Skip pauses and homes". A Pause/Home entry folding into a skipping op's gap is muted with it (it cannot refuse), and an entry ahead of every posted op follows the first posted op's switch.
- The Output/thread agreement check moved from the retired one-mount clause into the program gate. It stays program-wide (stricter than #388's per-mount files), as noted in the decision record.

New pin: `setup_post_options::an_entry_in_a_skipping_setups_gap_is_muted_with_its_op`. A Go-home entry after Setup2's stop refuses the program until Setup2 skips; then Setup1 keeps its stop and Setup2's op and its entry are muted, and undo restores the refusal.

Merged tree: `setup_post_options` 9/9, `program_entry` 7/7, `posting` 17, `per_op_files` 9, `after_op` 10, `conformance` 6, `setup_mount` 6, `setup_mounts_post` 5, ui `setup_post_options` 3 and `structural` 3, all passing; clippy on app+ui clean. Fork synced at v0.15.0. Stays a draft until it is flagged ready again.
Back to draft: main moved again after the earlier merge and #515 conflicts with it. Merging current main, re-gating, and flagging ready again once it's green.

Re-merged current main (`78f0e8cf`, a clean merge) and re-gated on the merged tree: `setup_post_options` 9, `program_entry` 9, `posting` 17, `per_op_files` 9, `after_op` 10, `conformance` 6, `setup_mount` 6, `setup_mounts_post` 5, ui `setup_post_options` 3, all passing; clippy app+ui clean. Flagging ready again (user OK earlier today).

Merged main to resolve conflicts:
- `egui_app/tests.rs`: keep both.
- `project/wire.rs`: this PR's document-level `setup_post_options::document` source, plus main's #596 `end_units` condition. Both intents are kept.
- `project/setup_options_dto.rs`: main's new `PostOptions::end_units` field is now carried through a setup's own options. It's an optional key, absent when left modal, and an unknown word is refused by the setup's name. Without it, a setup's own end unit would be lost on save.

Pinned by `setup_post_options`, whose round-trip test now sets and checks `end_units: inch`.

Targeted gate:
- app lib 103, `setup_post_options` 9, `project_roundtrip` 71, `tormach_end_units` 6, `tool_list` 2, `posting` 17, `float_roundtrip` 7, ui lib 426: all green.
- clippy `-D warnings` on app (lib + those tests) and ui (lib + tests): clean.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). The `setup_options_dto.rs` change is a small resolution beyond keep-both, so it deserves a delta review. The PR is back to draft per the no-pushes-while-ready rule, and I'll re-flag it ready.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e04a875d30f2d54cb63e2a8653b37e819a27c5ae -->
Delta review (merge of main since 78f0e8cf): clean.

Only commit since the last review is the merge of main (4827fde6). Checked: `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the PR's own 25 files (nothing from main dropped). The two conflicts are resolved with both sides kept: `egui_app/tests.rs` keeps `mod mcp_live` and `mod setup_post_options`; `project/wire.rs` reads the setup-aware `setup_post_options::document()` and takes main's `end_units != default` condition, so a document with only #596's end unit still writes its `post_options` key. The hand-written integration threads `end_units` through `SetupPostOptionsDto` (absent = modal, unknown value refused by name on read), and the pinning test now asserts `"end_units": "inch"` round-trips through a setup's own options. No safety check lost.

Tests (debug): app `setup_post_options` 9/9, `program_entry`, `posting` 17, `tormach_end_units` 7/7, ui lib `setup_post_options` 3/3. `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --lib` and the touched test target with `-D warnings`: clean.
